sentence: The single human detail that made this plate famous, in other words, is itself a matter of interpretation rather than settled fact, a different kind of contested \"first\" than [the disputed date on the watercolor credited as art's first fully abstract painting](/abstract-art-first-painting/), but built from the same raw material: a claim that outran what the surviving evidence can actually support.
